description: This file defines the Person class, a core component of the openmrs-core project. It models a person with attributes such as names, addresses, birthdate, death date, gender, and related metadata. The class includes methods for managing personal data, calculating age, handling attributes, and retrieving preferred addresses and names.

classes.name: Person
classes.description: Represents a person entity in the system, encapsulating personal details such as name, gender, birth/death information, addresses, attributes, and related metadata. Provides methods for managing person data, calculating age, and handling associated addresses and attributes.

methods.name: getPersonId
methods.description: Returns the internal identifier for this person.

methods.name: setPersonId
methods.description: Sets the internal identifier for this person.

methods.name: getGender
methods.description: Returns the gender of the person.

methods.name: setGender
methods.description: Sets the gender of the person.

methods.name: getBirthdate
methods.description: Returns the birthdate of the person.

methods.name: setBirthdate
methods.description: Sets the birthdate of the person.

methods.name: getBirthdateEstimated
methods.description: Indicates whether the birthdate is estimated.

methods.name: setBirthdateEstimated
methods.description: Sets whether the birthdate is estimated.

methods.name: getDeathdateEstimated
methods.description: Indicates whether the death date is estimated.

methods.name: setDeathdateEstimated
methods.description: Sets whether the death date is estimated.

methods.name: getDead
methods.description: Returns whether the person is marked as dead.

methods.name: setDead
methods.description: Sets the person's death status.

methods.name: getDeathDate
methods.description: Returns the date of person's death.

methods.name: setDeathDate
methods.description: Sets the date of person's death.

methods.name: getCauseOfDeath
methods.description: Returns the concept representing the cause of death.

methods.name: setCauseOfDeath
methods.description: Sets the cause of death of the person.

methods.name: getCauseOfDeathNonCoded
methods.description: Returns the non-coded cause of death as a human-readable string.

methods.name: setCauseOfDeathNonCoded
methods.description: Sets the non-coded cause of death.

methods.name: getAddresses
methods.description: Returns the set of addresses associated with the person.

methods.name: setAddresses
methods.description: Sets the addresses associated with the person.

methods.name: getNames
methods.description: Returns the set of names associated with the person.

methods.name: setNames
methods.description: Sets the names associated with the person.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Returns all attributes associated with the person.

methods.name: setAttributes
methods.description: Sets the person's attributes.

methods.name: getActiveAttributes
methods.description: Returns the non-voided attributes.

methods.name: addAttribute
methods.description: Adds or updates an attribute for the person, handling voiding or removing existing ones as necessary.

methods.name: removeAttribute
methods.description: Removes an attribute from the person.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves a non-voided attribute matching a given PersonAttribute or attribute type.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves a PersonAttribute by attribute name.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves a PersonAttribute by attribute type ID.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves all attributes with a specified attribute name.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves all attributes with a specified attribute type ID.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves all non-voided attributes matching a specified PersonAttributeType.

methods.name: getAttributeMap
methods.description: Returns a map of attribute type name to attribute for all active attributes.

methods.name: getAllAttributeMap
methods.description: Returns a map of all attributes (including voided) by attribute type name.

methods.name: printAttributes
methods.description: Returns a string listing all attributes with their types, values, and voided status.

methods.name: addName
methods.description: Adds a PersonName to the person's list of names if it does not already exist.

methods.name: removeName
methods.description: Removes a PersonName from the person's list of names.

methods.name: addAddress
methods.description: Adds a PersonAddress to the person's list of addresses if it does not already exist and is not blank.

methods.name: removeAddress
methods.description: Removes a PersonAddress from the person's list.

methods.name: getPersonName
methods.description: Returns the preferred, non-voided name; falls back to most recent or voided name based on conditions.

methods.name: getGivenName
methods.description: Returns the given name from the preferred PersonName, or empty string if none.

methods.name: getMiddleName
methods.description: Returns the middle name from the preferred PersonName, or empty string if none.

methods.name: getFamilyName
methods.description: Returns the family name from the preferred PersonName, or empty string if none.

methods.name: getPersonAddress
methods.description: Returns the preferred, non-voided address; falls back similarly to getPersonName.

methods.name: getAge
methods.description: Calculates the person's age based on the birthdate and current or specified date, considering death if applicable.

methods.name: getAge
methods.description: Calculates the person's age on a specific date.

methods.name: getAgeInMonths
methods.description: Returns the person's age in months.

methods.name: getAgeInWeeks
methods.description: Returns the person's age in weeks.

methods.name: getAgeInDays
methods.description: Returns the person's age in days.

methods.name: getAgeInChronoUnit
methods.description: Helper method that calculates age in specified ChronoUnit (days, weeks, months).

methods.name: setBirthdateFromAge
methods.description: Sets the birthdate based on an age as of a given date, marking the date as estimated.

methods.name: getPersonChangedBy
methods.description: Returns the User who last changed this Person record.

methods.name: setPersonChangedBy
methods.description: Sets the User who last changed this Person record.

methods.name: getPersonDateChanged
methods.description: Returns the date when this Person was last changed.

methods.name: setPersonDateChanged
methods.description: Sets the last changed date.

methods.name: getPersonCreator
methods.description: Returns the User who created this Person record.

methods.name: setPersonCreator
methods.description: Sets the creator User.

methods.name: getPersonDateCreated
methods.description: Returns the creation date of this Person.

methods.name: setPersonDateCreated
methods.description: Sets the creation date.

methods.name: getPersonDateVoided
methods.description: Returns the date when this Person record was voided.

methods.name: setPersonDateVoided
methods.description: Sets the voided date.

methods.name: setPersonVoided
methods.description: Marks the person as voided or unvoided.

methods.name: getPersonVoided
methods.description: Returns voided status.

methods.name: isPersonVoided
methods.description: Deprecated method, same as getPersonVoided.

methods.name: getPersonVoidedBy
methods.description: Returns the User who voided the record.

methods.name: setPersonVoidedBy
methods.description: Sets the user who voided the record.

methods.name: getPersonVoidReason
methods.description: Returns the reason for voiding.

methods.name: setPersonVoidReason
methods.description: Sets the void reason.

methods.name: isPatient
methods.description: Returns whether this person is a patient; deprecated, use getIsPatient().

methods.name: getIsPatient
methods.description: Returns true if person is marked as a patient.

methods.name: setPatient
methods.description: Protected method, sets the patient status; should only be called by the database layer.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the person, including ID.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the internal ID (alias for getPersonId).

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the internal ID (alias for setPersonId).
